title: org.projectfile.image extension (v1)
description: Standalone contract for the value at the org.projectfile.image subtree: the image a project publishes, declared as PARTS and TEMPLATES. Every name the image carries — its repository path, the tags each build publishes, and how a build variant enters a tag — is a template the document declares; the specification fixes no naming convention. The mechanism is defined in conformance/image/README.md.

org.description: Owning namespace, a part templates compose from.

name.description: Repository name, a part templates compose from.

path.description: Template of the nested repository path, over the parts (`${org}/${name}`, `${org}/${name}/${series}`).

flatpath.description: Template of the one-segment repository path for a registry that allows no nesting.

tag.description: Load tag of a local, unpublished build.

heads.description: The tags each kind of build publishes, as templates over the build facts `${version}`, `${major}`, `${minor}`, `${patch}` and `${branch}`. A kind left undeclared publishes what the publisher defaults to.

trunk.description: A push to a primary branch.

branch.description: A push to any other branch.

variant.description: How a build variant enters the tag. Absent: every cell publishes the heads unchanged.

parts.description: Ordered names of the parts that form the variant; each part is a template over matrix axes (`series: "{B19_PHP_SERIES}"`).

join.description: Separator between part values. Absent: the empty string.

aliases.description: `defaults` also publishes every combination with default-valued parts dropped. Absent: `none`.

tag.description: Template of a tag over `${head}` and `${variant}`.

bare.description: Heads whose tag is the variant alone. Absent: none.

additionalProperties.description: A free PART a template composes from (`series`, `sapi`); a new part is a new key.
